summary_1line: Kunti reveals Karna’s true birth and begs him to join the Pandavas, but Karna refuses out of loyalty to Duryodhana, promising to spare all brothers except Arjuna.

image_candidates.scene_text: Kunti stands before Karna at sunrise, confessing he is her son as the radiant sun glows behind him.
A divine voice from the blazing solar disk speaks to Karna, affirming Kunti’s words while he stands silent and resolute.
Kunti, trembling with grief, embraces the unmoved Karna after he vows to fight Arjuna but spare her other sons.
